intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: The towers above the water hang upside down in it, wobbling slightly.

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “From down here, your city appears to be built underneath mine. Everyone is walking on the ceiling.”

intro.speaker: NERELLE
intro.text: “It looks very well run. Nobody in that one has ever asked me to sign anything.”

intro.speaker: NARRATOR
intro.text: A ripple passes through. The towers shiver apart and slowly reassemble.

options.labelText: “Hold on. Let me look from your height.”

branch.speaker: NARRATOR
branch.text: You kneel at the edge until your chin is nearly touching the water. The upside-down towers sway in front of you.

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Welcome. From here, you’re taller than the palace.”

options.labelText: “Technically the real city’s up here. That’s just light bouncing.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “Thank you. We have light under the sea as well. It is how we see boats coming.”

branch.speaker: NERELLE
branch.text: “I preferred the upside-down city. It never explains things.”
